title: Power BI sales dashboard
text: Client: retail company with regional managers waiting a week for sales reports. Built a star-schema model and a Power BI dashboard with row-level security. Result: replaced 12 manual weekly reports with one refreshed daily. Managers see only their region.

title: Excel reporting automation with VBA and Power Query
text: Client: logistics company with a finance team spending two days a month consolidating spreadsheets. Automated consolidation with Power Query and a VBA export macro. Result: cut month-end reporting from two days to 40 minutes. Includes a one-page guide for the team.

title: SQL cohort and retention analysis
text: Client: saas company with a product team unsure which features kept users. Wrote cohort and retention queries over 2 million events and summarised findings. Result: identified the onboarding step linked to a 15-point retention gap. Queries were delivered as reusable views.

title: sql-cohorts: SQL cohort and retention analysis
text: SQL cohort and retention analysis. Open-source reference implementation of the approach: wrote cohort and retention queries over 2 million events and summarised findings. Stack: SQL, PostgreSQL, cohort analysis, Python. Includes setup instructions, tests and a sample dataset.

title: sql-cohorts/main module
text: Core module of sql-cohorts: SQL, PostgreSQL, cohort analysis implementation with configuration, logging, retries and unit tests covering the main paths.

title: Tableau dashboard for clinic operations
text: Client: healthcare company with clinics with no view of appointment no-shows. Built a Tableau dashboard of bookings, no-shows and wait times across 9 clinics. Result: helped reduce no-shows by 18% after reminder changes. Only aggregated, de-identified data was used.

title: Product price scraping and monitoring
text: Client: ecommerce company with a retailer tracking competitor prices by hand. Built Scrapy spiders respecting robots.txt with daily price-change reports. Result: tracked 8,000 products across 5 competitor sites. Alerts fire when a price drops more than 10%.

title: scraping: Product price scraping and monitoring
text: Product price scraping and monitoring. Open-source reference implementation of the approach: built Scrapy spiders respecting robots.txt with daily price-change reports. Stack: Python, web scraping, BeautifulSoup, Scrapy, pandas. Includes setup instructions, tests and a sample dataset.

title: scraping/main module
text: Core module of scraping: Python, web scraping, BeautifulSoup implementation with configuration, logging, retries and unit tests covering the main paths.

title: A/B test analysis for a checkout redesign
text: Client: ecommerce company with a team about to ship a redesign on gut feel. Designed the test with a power calculation and analysed it with confidence intervals. Result: showed a 0.4-point conversion lift with a 95% interval excluding zero. Results were written up for non-technical stakeholders.

title: CRM data cleaning and deduplication
text: Client: real estate company with a CRM with thousands of duplicate and malformed contacts. Standardised fields and fuzzy-matched duplicates with a review sheet. Result: merged 4,300 duplicates out of 21,000 contacts. Nothing was deleted without a review flag.

title: Google Sheets KPI tracker with Apps Script
text: Client: nonprofit company with a nonprofit collecting KPIs by email. Built a Google Sheets tracker with Apps Script validation and a Looker Studio report. Result: got all 25 programme leads reporting on time. Volunteers can update it without training.
